category: Application Library examples: Metal Processing Module
description: Ready-made, documented example simulations installed with the Metal Processing Module. Each lists its physics interfaces, couplings and study steps; solve one with comsol_run_example or adapt its Java build script.

tools.name: Calibration Against TTT Data [Metal Processing Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Metal Processing Module (Transformation Diagrams): Calibration Against TTT Data. Physics interfaces: GlobalMetalPhaseTransformation (metp2), GlobalMetalPhaseTransformation (metp). Study steps: Parameter Estimation, Parametric Sweep, Time Dependent. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.
tools.usage: MCP: comsol_run_example("Metal_Processing_Module/Transformation_Diagrams/calibration_against_ttt_data") to solve it, comsol_example_info("calibration_against_ttt_data", include_java=true) for its build script. COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Metal Processing Module > Transformation Diagrams > calibration against ttt data
tools.notes: Library path Metal_Processing_Module/Transformation_Diagrams/calibration_against_ttt_data; model file 1.2 MB. Documented Java build script available (rebuild with comsol_run_example method='java'). Requires the module licence to open and solve.

tools.name: Carburization and Quenching of a Steel Gear [Metal Processing Module example]
tools.description: Application Library example of the Metal Processing Module (Steel Quenching): Carburization and Quenching of a Steel Gear. Physics interfaces: Austenite Decomposition (audc), Carburization (carb), Heat Transfer in Solids (ht), Solid Mechanics (solid). Multiphysics couplings: PhaseTransformationLatentHeat, PhaseTransformationStrain. Study steps: Time Dependent. A ready model to start from for a similar simulation.

COMSOL: File > Application Libraries > Metal Processing Module > Steel Quenching > carburization and quenching of a steel gear
